description: This source file defines the `CalendarService` class that implements calendar-related functionalities, such as retrieving events and adding new events using EventKit on iOS. It handles permission checks, date range resolution, and interacts with calendars and events through EventKit APIs.

classes.name: CalendarService
classes.description: Implements the `CalendarServicing` protocol to provide methods for fetching calendar events and adding new events using EventKit, with permission handling and date range management.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Fetches calendar events within a specified range and limits, returning a payload of event summaries.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new calendar event based on provided parameters, handling permission checks, date parsing, and calendar resolution.
